home.titleBottom: to query your documents intelligently, within your constraints.
home.lead: RAG connects an AI model to your own documents: it finds the relevant passages, then writes an answer that cites them. Nothing made up, everything checkable.

steps.title: A question
steps.text: Asked in plain language, as you would ask a colleague.

steps.title: A search
steps.text: The relevant passages, found among thousands of pages.

steps.title: An answer with sources
steps.text: Every claim points back to its original document.

demos.title: Try it on real cases
demos.lead: Nine real-world scenarios, each with its method, architecture, measured quality and cost. Built mostly on AWS (Bedrock, S3 Vectors), with Mistral or OpenAI where the case calls for it.

process.title: From scoping to production
process.lead: A RAG project moves in short steps, each with a measurable outcome.

familyIntro.search: Find things fast and cheaply, even across millions of documents.
familyIntro.structure: Respect the structure of documents and data: contents pages, tables, links.
familyIntro.verification: Check every answer before it reaches the user.
familyIntro.agents: Reason in several steps, use tools, know when to hand over.
familyIntro.sovereignty: Keep data in-house, with open models.
familyIntro.multimodal: Understand images, diagrams, audio and video.

demos.title: Demos
demos.lead: Nine real-world scenarios, from an internal knowledge base to a 20-million-row data lake. Every demo runs live and comes with its architecture, data pipeline, evaluation results and running costs.

methods.title: The methods
methods.lead: There is no single RAG, but families of methods, each suited to a problem. Every demo stars one of them, as a character, up against classic RAG.

whatIsRag.title: What is RAG?
whatIsRag.lead: How an AI assistant can answer from your documents and show its sources, and when it isn't the right tool.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Four ways to work together, from a two-day scoping audit to a production rollout, plus a dedicated format for improving a RAG system you already run.

dataEngineering.title: Data engineering for AI
dataEngineering.lead: A reliable RAG system is first and foremost a sound data pipeline: ingestion, transformation, storage, updates and security. The language model comes last.

articles.title: Articles
articles.lead: Technical write-ups for each demo: what worked, what was ruled out, and why.

about.title: About
about.lead: A Python developer specialised in RAG systems and data pipelines.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: A few lines are enough: the kind of documents, how many, and your constraints. The reply comes with a first assessment and a few pointed questions.
